drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel, please find our initial revisions for discussion, subject to client review and approval. We have clarified payment mechanics, tied the release to receipt of funds, and added customary confidentiality exceptions. The settlement amount, payment deadline, and appropriate release scope remain open for agreement.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] within [NUMBER] business days after both parties execute this Agreement, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Plaintiff shall provide payment instructions through a mutually verified channel.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in immediately available funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the dispute described in [IDENTIFY DISPUTE], based on acts or omissions occurring on or before execution of this Agreement. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; and disclosures required by law or legal process. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful communications with, reporting to, or cooperation with governmental or regulatory authorities, or requires prior notice or consent for such communications.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute specifically described as [IDENTIFY DISPUTE] (the “Dispute”), on the terms set forth in this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten (10) business days after both parties execute this Agreement, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Plaintiff shall provide payment instructions through a mutually verified channel.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in immediately available funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all known and unknown claims arising out of the Dispute, based on acts or omissions occurring on or before execution of this Agreement by both parties. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or to claims to enforce this Agreement. Nothing in this release limits the permitted disclosures, communications, reporting, or cooperation described in Section 3.
